iwn-mwt-f: iwn-mwt-f — Iun-mut-ef, 'Pillar of his mother', a title of Horus as the son of Osiris and Isis, also borne by a priest who takes the son's part in the rites for the dead (name/title; from iwn 'pillar', mwt 'mother' and ·f 'his'; Budge: Ān-māut-f)
sꜣ-mr-f: sꜣ-mr-f — Sa-mer-ef, 'the son whom he loves', a title of Horus as the beloved son of Osiris, also borne by a priest who takes the son's part in the rites for the dead (name/title; from sꜣ 'son' and mr·f, the relative form of mri 'love'; Budge: Se-mer-f)
ꜥpr: ꜥpr — to equip, provide (verb; stative ꜥpr·kwi 'I am equipped'; written with the sign ꜥpr, a bag on a cord; Budge: āper)

__broaden__.sḫr: sḫr — to overthrow, fell (causative verb, from ḫr 'fall'); to harm, bring to ruin (?) (sense uncertain) · a second word of the same spelling: plan, counsel, design (noun m.; plural sḫrw; Budge: seχeru)
